summary: Embotelladora Andina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the placement of Series J bonds in the Chilean local market. The bonds total UF 2,500,000, carry a 2.95% interest rate with a 3.10% annual coupon, and mature September 30, 2030. Proceeds will refinance liabilities, fund investments, or for other corporate purposes, with intent to allocate an equivalent amount to eligible green projects under the Coca-Cola Andina Green Bond/Sustainable Bond Framework. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation, involving no equity, merger, or strategic event. The filing discloses no deal terms applicable to special-situations categories.
